sources_read: .qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r2/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: Quality Checks row 11 (#10 verifier_is_isolated_pinned_and_credentialed); Internal Quality Checks row 11 (older '+ allowlist' wording, superseded by current Quality Checks text and skill delivery profile: public network, no allowlist); Deterministic Checks C2, C7, C11, C29 for cross-reference
evidence: Isolation: task/task.toml:27-28 `[verifier] timeout_sec = 13200.0` / `environment_mode = "separate"`. Credential block: task/task.toml:30-35 is exactly REWARDKIT_JUDGE = "claude-code", REWARDKIT_MODEL = "z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx", ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL = "https://openrouter.ai/api", ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}", ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = ""; `diff` of everything from `[verifier]` to EOF against the frozen template task.toml is empty (byte-equal), and it matches staged-task-contract.md lines 66-71. task.toml sha256 ac664d0e...9e068f26. [verifier.environment] network_mode = "public"; no allowed_hosts/allow_internet/docker_image keys (grep empty) - correct per skill delivery profile (public network, no allowlist required). Pinned image: task/tests/Dockerfile (sha256 72998ab8...a55fdd) is byte-identical to the template tests/Dockerfile (diff empty): bases node:22-bookworm-slim and python:3.12-slim (version tags, template-controlled), npm @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281, @openai/codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1, pip harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7, Chromium installed via the pinned Playwright CLI; COPY . /tests then chmod -R go-rwx /tests. .dockerignore and tests/tools/* also identical to template. The agent image (environment/Dockerfile) copies only /instructions and /assets, so tests/criteria are not in the agent container. Judge files: all five judge.toml carry `judge = "claude-code"` (line 2, matches REWARDKIT_JUDGE), mode/timeout/isolated/prompt_template; grep for model|reasoning|temperature in all five returns nothing; no weight key inside [judge] (weight appears only in [[criterion]] blocks). Their [judge] and MCP headers diff empty against the template except criterion ids. test.sh (identical to template) refuses to grade without REWARDKIT_JUDGE/REWARDKIT_MODEL (lines 63-66). Counterexample attempts: a broken app cannot alter verifier env or judge model (wiring is in task.toml/tests only, absent from agent image); a conforming app cannot fail due to this row since the block is the unchanged shared one. Limit: this is a static configuration check. raw-evidence-index.json states full configured grading is absent, so OpenRouter authentication through this block is not runtime-exercised in this round; that measurement belongs to the verifier-launch/grading rows (22/23) and does not create a defect here because the block is byte-equal to the frozen shared template.
